title: Building Event-Driven Systems with Kafka
content: Apache Kafka has become the backbone of modern event-driven architectures. In this guide, we explore patterns for building reliable microservices using Kafka as the central message broker. Topics covered include consumer groups, exactly-once semantics, and schema evolution with Avro.

title: Andrej Karpathy on LLM training
content: Thread: The most underrated aspect of LLM training is data quality. You can throw 10x more compute at bad data and still lose to a smaller model trained on curated data. This is why synthetic data generation is so important.

title: Brutalist Architecture in Tokyo
content: A striking photograph of the National Museum of Western Art designed by Le Corbusier. The raw concrete surfaces and geometric forms exemplify the brutalist movement.

title: Breaking Down the Ollie Technique
content: A step-by-step tutorial on how to perform a clean ollie. Covers foot placement, timing, and common mistakes beginners make.

title: The Mathematics of Origami
content: How computational geometry and origami intersect. Explores Huzita-Hatori axioms and their applications in engineering, from solar panel deployment to medical stent design.
